en.title: Obligation and necessity
en.summary: Must, have to and need to express obligation.

paragraphs: English expresses obligation with the modal verb must and the phrases have to, have got to and need to. They differ in who feels the obligation and how strong it is.

Must usually shows the speaker's own feeling or a strong rule: I must stop smoking. Have to shows an outside rule or a necessity: I have to wear a uniform at work. In everyday speech, have to is more usual, and it works in all tenses.

blocks.html:
TenseFormExample
presentmust / have toYou must / have to be quiet.
pasthad toI had to wait.
futurewill have toWe will have to hurry.
questiondo / does / did + have toDo you have to go?
negative (not necessary)don't have toYou don't have to come.

paragraphs: Need to is similar to have to and is used for necessity in all tenses. Needn't (need not) means that it is not necessary. Compare don't have to, which is more common in everyday speech.

blocks.html:
FormExample
need to + verbI need to buy a ticket.
don't need toYou don't need to hurry.
needn't + verbYou needn't come.
needn't have + participleYou needn't have waited. (you waited, but it was not necessary)

paragraphs: Must not (mustn't) and don't have to are completely different: mustn't means that something is forbidden, while don't have to means that something is not necessary.

blocks.html:
FormMeaning
You mustn't park here.forbidden
You don't have to park here.not necessary; you may if you like

items: Wrong: **I must to go.** Right: **I must go.**
Wrong: **She musts work.** Right: **She must work.**
Wrong: **I musted go.** Right: **I had to go.**
Wrong: **You don't must smoke.** Right: **You mustn't smoke.**

ro.title: Obligație și necesitate
ro.summary: În limba română, exprimăm obligația și necesitatea în special cu verbul impersonal „trebuie” urmat de „să”.

paragraphs: Exprimăm obligația când o acțiune este necesară sau cerută de o regulă. În limba română, folosim cel mai des verbul „a trebui”. După „trebuie”, punem întotdeauna un alt verb cu particula „să”. Nu folosim niciodată forma de infinitiv cu „a” după acest verb.

La timpul prezent, forma „trebuie” rămâne identică pentru toate persoanele. Doar verbul de după „să” își schimbă terminația în funcție de persoană. Pentru negație, punem cuvântul „nu” înaintea verbului „trebuie”.

blocks.html:
PersoanăStructurăExemplu
Eutrebuie să + verbTrebuie să lucrez azi.
Tutrebuie să + verbTrebuie să mănânci supa.
Noitrebuie să + verbTrebuie să plecăm acum.
Voinu trebuie să + verbNu trebuie să alergați.
